messages.content: 在一個熱力學實驗中，你被要求計算一個過程的熵變化。該過程開始時的溫度為300克耳文，結束時的溫度為350克耳文。系統的熱容量為4.18焦耳/克耳文。該過程是等溫的。你能計算出該過程的熵變化嗎？如果該過程不是等溫的，熵變化會有什麼不同？

function.name: calculate_entropy_change
function.description: Calculate the entropy change for an isothermal and reversible process. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

heat_capacity.description: The heat capacity in J/K. This is a float type value.

isothermal.description: Whether the process is isothermal. Default is True.

message.reasoning: We need to compute entropy change for isothermal reversible process: ΔS = Q_rev / T. For isothermal, Q_rev = nRT ln(V2/V1) or ΔS = C ln(T2/T1) if heat capacity constant? Wait for isothermal reversible process, ΔS = ∫ δQ_rev/T = Q_rev/T. But Q_rev depends on work done. For a system with constant heat capacity, if not isothermal, ΔS = ∫ C/T dT = C ln(T2/T1). But if isothermal, T constant, so ΔS = Q_rev/T. But Q_rev = ∫ δQ_rev = ∫ δW_rev? For reversible isothermal, δQ_rev = δW_rev = -P dV. But we don't have volume change. So maybe they want formula: ΔS = C ln(T2/T1). But if isothermal, T2=T1, so ln(1)=0, so ΔS=0. But that seems wrong: isothermal reversible process can have nonzero entropy change if system does work? Actually for a reversible isothermal process of an ideal gas, ΔS = nR ln(V2/V1). But if we only know heat capacity, we can't compute ΔS unless we know volume change. But maybe they assume heat capacity constant and process is isothermal, so ΔS = 0 because no temperature change. But the question: "該過程是等溫的。你能計算出該過程的熵變化嗎？如果該過程不是等溫的，熵變化會有什麼不同？" They want to use the function calculate_entropy_change. Provide arguments: initial_temp=300, final_temp=350, heat_capacity=4.18, isothermal=True. Then call function. Then explain difference if not isothermal: ΔS = C ln(T2/T1). So we need to call function.
